adam.name: Adam - Epistemic Patriarch
core_strengths: Strict radius and distance calculation (km radius filter)
Hardened categorical schema (Q1-Q7 with explicit codes)
failure_risks: Risk of feeling clinical or transactional (like a rugged classifieds board)
Less emphasis on relational dignity or reducing the shame of asking

eve.name: Eve - Epistemic Matriarch
core_strengths: Reciprocal Match Weaver (automatic loop matching: Jack needs A/gives B <-> Claire gives A/needs B)
Dual-sided post cards showing 'Gives' and 'Asks' simultaneously to erase charity stigma
Tactile, warm earth/linen palette tailored for community welcome
failure_risks: Softer spatial constraints (less emphasis on exact kilometer radius)
Lower visual contrast under bright direct sunlight in outdoor work conditions

inherited_from_adam: High-contrast mode option and explicit day rate/compensation tags
inherited_from_eve: Dual Give/Ask structure on every card to eradicate charity stigma
Warm human storytelling context alongside technical specs
